newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares close sluggish day up on technicals.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares close sluggish day up on technicals.

text.p: 1535 GMT - Dutch blue chip index closes up, helped by index-heavy financials as bonds continue firm. Dealers say month-end window-dressing, low-level demand from so-called click funds also serve to drive shares up in absence of major offering. Other European exchanges and modestly higher Wall Street opening also give support. String of small cap results but no major stories in the market.
* AEX ends up 6.59 points at 740.99, back from earlier high
* Philips pares early gains to close up 0.50 at 87.50.
